overflow_conservative_transfer.interpretation: The storage bound is reached by explicit mass transfer to runoff, not by hidden clipping.

transaction_claim: For the frozen restricted surface-water seam, accepted trials publish surface state and diagnostic ledgers atomically after exact balance checks; depletion and injected rejection leave committed time, physical state and cumulative ledgers bitwise unchanged. Surface overflow is an explicit conservative runoff transfer. Continuation beyond a depletion event with stale qtop is forbidden.

architecture_checks.2_kernel_io_separation: qualified seam is calculation-only and I/O-free
architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: state, forcing, soil-face result, trial scratch and result ledger are separate
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: reject rollback is bitwise exact in both frozen rejection routes
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: surface and composed test-system balances close exactly in all accepted dyadic cases
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: only the generic soil-face flux result is consumed
architecture_checks.22_no_headcalc_internals: no solver internal arrays are exposed
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: storage capacity and fluxes are physical inputs; retry/commit is transaction policy
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: accept/reject reason, event dt, transfers and residuals are explicit
architecture_checks.27_optional_functionality_scales: no optional top-boundary modules are allocated
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: no calendar, file, midnight or coupling assumption

hard_nonclaims: No real Richards state update is implemented or qualified in E3F.
No physical decomposition of precipitation, interception, snow, runon, irrigation or evaporation is qualified.
No post-event top-boundary mode re-solve is implemented.
No response tangent across a surface-storage or endpoint switch is qualified.
No full top-boundary composition, production runtime, MultiSWAP or groundwater admission follows from E3F.
The synthetic soil receiver is qualification scaffolding only and is not production persistent state.
